title: Message to Hormel Foods Team Members From New CEO John Ghingo
summary: The post Message to Hormel Foods Team Members From New CEO John Ghingo appeared first on Hormel Foods .
body_markdown:
To my Hormel Foods colleagues,


As I wrap up my first week as CEO, I want to thank you for the warm reception and for the commitment you bring to Hormel Foods every day.


This is a special company. We’ve come a long way from the small butcher shop where our story began in Austin, Minn., more than 135 years ago. Generations of Hormel Foods employees have made that possible by evolving with the times, staying close to the people we serve and always looking for better ways to deliver for our customers around the world.


That same spirit continues to define us today. We have a strong strategy in place, a broad portfolio of iconic brands and talented people who understand what it takes to deliver great food and great value across our Retail, Foodservice and International businesses.


We also have a clear purpose: Fueling every day with real food for real life. I see that purpose reflected in the work you do every day and in the products and brands people count on.


Our focus is clear: execute our strategy with discipline, move with greater speed and continue adapting to evolving consumer and customer needs. That will take all of us staying curious, listening closely, making smart decisions and taking ownership for delivering results. Together, we can build on our momentum, strengthen our brands and create meaningful growth.


This week, I’ve had the opportunity to connect with many of you, and I’m grateful for the conversations, the candor and the pride you have in this company.


Thank you for the commitment, ownership and care you bring to your work. You are the people behind the products our consumers welcome into their homes and their lives, and the solutions our customers and operators count on every day. That trust is a privilege, and one we have to continue earning together.


As I begin this role, I have tremendous confidence in our people, our strategy and the opportunity in front of us. We have a strong foundation, real momentum and an incredible opportunity to build on both.


Our best days are ahead of us.


John
